description: Extra requests added on top of the supplied set to cover edges the shared data does not reach: enum violations, unparsable numbers, the exact policy boundaries, a vendor absent from the risk database, and a public-data request. The supplied files are used unchanged; these are additional inputs only.

requests.note: Cost exactly at the threshold. 'Above USD 10,000' excludes 10,000, so this must not escalate on cost.
One cent above the threshold; must escalate on cost.
Data type outside the allowed enum; the value cannot be interpreted, so information is requested.
Vendor absent from the risk database; no current evidence exists, so escalate rather than approve.
Cost supplied as a formatted string; coerced to a number rather than rejected.
Cost that cannot be parsed; the schema must reject it instead of guessing.
Public data needs only a current vendor-risk record.
Restricted data, cost over the limit, and a prohibited high-risk vendor all at once. Rejection is the strictest applicable action and must win.
Whitespace-only vendor name counts as missing, not as a vendor called ' '.
